own_solution.law: Translational kinetic energy is K = (1/2)mv² = (1/2)(2.0 kg)(6.0 m/s)² = 36 J.
assumptions: The stated speed and requested translational kinetic energy refer to the laboratory frame.
Classical mechanics is adequate at the stated speed; relativistic corrections are negligible at the given precision.

notes: The laboratory floor area is structurally disconnected (D) from the requested kinetic energy. All four variants give 36 J. The renderings differ only in floor area, consistently expressed in m²; these are separate parameter values in legacy variants, not contradictory simultaneous statements.
